name: codewithveek
description: Agent Skills by CodewithVeek — plain-language teaching, database schema engineering, and other practitioner tooling.

plugins.name: learn-simply
plugins.description: Explains any topic in plain, unambiguous language using ASD-STE100 (Simplified Technical English) principles.

plugins.name: knowledge-graph
plugins.description: Builds and maintains a codebase knowledge graph: one page per feature, a reading order with previous/next links, and tooling that tells you when a page has fallen behind the code it covers.

plugins.name: product-videos
plugins.description: Makes product videos with Remotion — launches, tutorials, explainers and vertical cutdowns — in four visual styles (studio, editorial, graphic, cinematic) with a recommended style per video type, with rebuilt app screens, camera and cursor, voiceover, music, sound effects, captions and thumbnails, showing only what the product really does.
